# Vendored libraries

- Chart.js 4.4.9: `chart.js--auto.js`, MIT; see `chartjs.LICENSE`.
- The Chart.js bundle includes @kurkle/color 0.3.4; its MIT attribution is retained in the bundle and full license is in `kurkle-color.LICENSE`.
- flatpickr 4.6.13: `flatpickr.js` and `app/assets/stylesheets/flatpickr.css`, MIT; see `flatpickr.LICENSE`.

ESM bundles were fetched from esm.sh with versioned URLs. CSS was fetched from the versioned npm distribution through jsDelivr. No runtime CDN requests are required.
